review_candidates.title: Engineer I
review_candidates.description: Description ECC is seeking candidates for an Engineer I position. This office and field position is primarily responsible for helping plan, select, coordinate and implement scientific and engineering services to fully address the scope of work on environmental and/or construction projects in accordance with Company standards, regulatory criteria, and contractual obligations. In this position, you will: Support daily field operations to ensure work is executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with contract documents, project schedules, and quality requirements. Review and interpret plans, specifications, shop drawings, and contract documents to support construction activities and resolve field issues. Coordinate and monitor work performed by subcontractors, suppliers, and field personnel to maintain project progress and productivity goals. Track and manage project RFIs, submittals, change requests, permits, and other construction-related documentation. Conduct routine field walks and inspections to verify compliance with project requirements, quality standards, safety expectations, and approved construction methods. Assist in developing and maintaining project schedules, short-interval plans, and look-ahead schedules in coordination with project management and field supervision. Support cost control efforts through quantity tracking, productivity monitoring, budget reporting, and change management processes. Coordinate material procurement, delivery schedules, equipment needs, and inventory to support uninterrupted field operations. Maintain accurate project records, including daily reports, meeting minutes, inspection reports, photographs, field observations, and as-built documentation. Participate in owner, subcontractor, and project coordination meetings; document action items and follow up to ensure timely resolution. Verify quantities completed, assist with subcontractor invoice reviews, and support project forecasting and reporting efforts. Assist with project closeout activities, including punch list management, turnover documentation, warranties, training materials, and final record drawings. Support implementation of project safety, environmental, and quality control programs in accordance with company policy and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with project managers, superintendents, owners, architects, engineers, and government representatives to address construction challenges and maintain project objectives. Perform additional project engineering, quality, procurement, project controls, and field coordination duties as assigned. In addition to the accountabilities above, other responsibilities, tasks, and deliverables may be assigned to the incumbent of this position Requirements Knowledge of construction means and methods, contract documents, project scheduling, and field execution practices. Ability to read, interpret, and apply construction drawings, specifications, submittals, and project plans. Understanding of construction safety requirements, OSHA standards, quality control procedures, and applicable building codes. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment. Ability to identify issues, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical field-based solutions. Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate activities among diverse project stakeholders. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with construction management software such as Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Bluebeam, or similar platforms. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a project team. Experience coordinating subcontractors, suppliers, and project stakeholders is preferred. Willingness and ability to work full-time at project sites, including travel or relocation as required by project needs. Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Construction Engineering, Civil Engineering, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered. Preferred Qualifications Prior internship, co-op, or professional experience supporting commercial, industrial, environmental, heavy civil, or federal construction projects. Working knowledge of construction management software such as Procore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or similar platforms. Relevant construction training or certifications in safety, quality control, scheduling, project controls, or contract administration (e.g., OSHA 30, CQM-C, EM 385-1-1). ECC targeted salary range for Guam is $62,000 to $74,000 annually. Actual salary offered may be affected by education, training, certifications, experience, skills, level of responsibility, and location. Benefits Offered for Full-Time positions: Medical/Dental/Prescription/Vision Insurance Life Insurance, Long Term Disability Insurance Paid Time off and Holiday Pay 401k with deferral matching, Student Debt Reduction Program Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) Educational Assistance, Mentorship Program, ECC University Employee Referral Bonus Program Company-matching charitable giving program ECC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact TeleSign HR at [email protected]. review_candidates.description: Descrição da empresa A Anglo American é uma empresa global de mineração com sede em Londres, presente em diversos países e com uma história de mais de 100 anos, com o propósito de reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Na América Latina, nossas operações desempenham um papel estratégico no fornecimento responsável de recursos essenciais para o desenvolvimento do mundo – com atuação no Brasil, Chile e Peru, sempre pautadas por inovação, segurança, sustentabilidade e alto desempenho. No Brasil, operamos o sistema Minas-Rio, que integra mina, usina, mineroduto e porto. As operações do Peru e do Chile se concentram na produção de cobre em larga escala, reforçando nosso compromisso com uma transição energética sustentável. Acreditamos que nossas pessoas são o maior diferencial competitivo. Investimos no desenvolvimento de talentos, promovendo ambientes inclusivos e colaborativos, onde diferentes perspectivas constroem soluções melhores para os desafios do presente e do futuro. Na Anglo American, valorizamos quem deseja crescer com propósito e gerar impacto real. Descrição da vaga Como Engenheira de Planejamento Sênior , você será responsável por liderar o planejamento, monitoramento e controle de projetos e obras de infraestrutura de pequeno, médio e grande porte, garantindo a integração das informações relacionadas a engenharia, suprimentos, contratos, cronogramas e controle de custos. Atuará na elaboração de cronogramas executivos, avaliação de prioridades de demandas, análises de desempenho, gestão de riscos e definição de estratégias para assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos de prazo, custo, qualidade e segurança. Veja abaixo as principais atividades: Elaborar, consolidar e controlar cronogramas de implantação de projetos e obras de infraestrutura utilizando, MS Project e demais ferramentas de planejamento. Desenvolver Estruturas Analíticas de Projeto, planos de execução, curvas de avanço físico e financeiro e cronogramas integrados. Realizar análises de caminho crítico, produtividade, riscos e restrições, propondo ações de mitigação. Monitorar e reportar o avanço financeiro do orçamento da gerência, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria no desempenho dos processos. Conduzir o planejamento de curto, médio e longo prazo, integrando engenharia, suprimentos, contratos e construção. Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para suporte à tomada de decisão da gerência e diretoria. Apoiar a definição estratégica de priorização de demandas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização nos processos de serviços, facilities e gestão operacional, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência, produtividade e qualidade das entregas. Apoiar estratégias de contratação, mobilização de recursos e dimensionamento de equipes e equipamentos. Coordenar reuniões de acompanhamento e promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de planejamento, controle e governança. Atuar como referência técnica da área, desenvolvendo profissionais e garantindo o cumprimento das políticas de Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente, Qualidade e Integridade Empresarial. Qualificações O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição: Ensino superior em Engenharia Civl, Produção e outras Engenharias. CREA ativo. CNH – B. Desejável Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos ou similar. Desejável experiência em planejamento de grandes projetos e obras de infraestrutura. Desejável inglês intermediário ou avançado. Informações adicionais Por que fazer parte do nosso time? Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios: Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional Especial para você e sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação! Espaço para ser você mesmo: Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade! Para seu futuro: Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado E ainda: Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico. Como estamos comprometidos com a sua segurança? Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura. Inclusão e Diversidade Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, no qual valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega por quem ela/ele é. Acolhemos e celebramos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. E foi para escutar todas essas vozes que criamos os Grupos de Afinidades: espaços seguros para discutir, refletir e construir ações de inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional. Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e sintam-se abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho. Reforçamos que todas as vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS. Nosso processo seletivo Para se candidatar a essa vaga, realize seu cadastro on-line, e anexe seu currículo no ato da inscrição. Nosso processo seletivo, de forma geral, é constituído das seguintes etapas: inscrição, análise dos currículos, dinâmica/entrevista, avaliação comportamental, exame médico e admissão. Fique atento à página da/do candidata/candidato, assim como aos meios de comunicação (e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp), pois todo o processo será mediado por essas plataformas. Venha com a gente construir o futuro da mineração!

We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. review_candidates.title: Digital Content and Social Media Expert
review_candidates.description: TECHNICAL ASSISTANT FACILITY FOR YEMEN TERMS OF REFERENCE Technical Assistant Facility for Yemen (TAFFY) is recruiting a Digital Content and Social Media Expert to support implementation of the Government of Yemen Communications Strategy under the TAFFY Programme. Working with the Project Management Team and the Ministry of Information (MOI), the Expert will develop and manage written digital content for the Ministry’s website, approved social media channels, and communications campaigns, while mentoring MOI staff in editorial planning, writing, review, publishing, and content management. The role complements the wider expert team by translating approved strategies, audience insights, key messages, and multimedia assets into accurate, engaging, and platform-appropriate content. Strategic direction and team coordination will remain with the Digital Communications Expert & Team Coordinator; audience research and analytics with the Audience Research & Data Analytics Expert; and visual and audiovisual production with the Multimedia Production Expert. The website component is limited to editorial content development, organisation, quality assurance, content migration, and CMS publishing support. It does not include website design, software development, hosting, cybersecurity, or technical maintenance. Principal Duties And Responsibilities (Essential Functions) Social Media and Campaign Content Translate approved campaign objectives, audience insights, narratives, and key messages into platform-specific content for Facebook, X, YouTube, and other approved channels. Draft and edit Arabic posts, captions, headlines, calls to action, short scripts, and content series; support English-language adaptation where required. Develop editorial calendars, content schedules, and publishing packages for the project’s approved campaigns and related strategic communications activities. Adapt content to each platform and audience while maintaining consistent, accurate, and approved government messaging. Coordinate with the Multimedia Production Expert so that copy, scripts, captions, subtitles, and calls to action align with visual and audiovisual assets. Support fact-checking, proofreading, approvals, scheduling, publication, and updating through agreed MOI and project workflows. Apply accessibility, gender equality and social inclusion, conflict sensitivity, safeguarding, and “Do No Harm” principles to all content. Use audience insights and performance findings provided by the Audience Research & Data Analytics Expert to refine content and publishing approaches. Website Content Draft, edit, structure, and quality-assure audience-centred content for the bilingual MOI website using approved information and authorised sources. Develop and organise copy for agreed sections, including the Ministry profile, leadership, strategic priorities, policies, media centre, news, publications, campaigns, and contact pages. Review existing material for clarity, consistency, accuracy, and online readability; identify content gaps and coordinate collection of missing information. Prepare CMS-ready page titles, summaries, headings, metadata, keywords, links, calls to action, image descriptions, and alternative text in line with basic SEO and accessibility good practice. Support Arabic–English content alignment, translation coordination, version control, content migration, CMS formatting, and editorial checks before launch. Liaise with the website supplier and relevant experts on page requirements and publishing workflows, without assuming responsibility for technical website development or maintenance. Establish practical routines for website updates, archiving, periodic content review, brokenlink checks, and correction or retirement of outdated material. Capacity Strengthening and Coordination Mentor designated MOI staff through collaborative planning, drafting, editing, publishing, and review, progressively transferring responsibility to the Ministry. Develop practical tone-of-voice and editorial guidance, templates, checklists, content trackers, approval workflows, and standard operating procedures. Facilitate regular content review sessions to agree priorities, address content gaps, maintain message consistency, and apply lessons learned. Maintain an organised content repository and tracker recording source, owner, language, approval status, publication date, and update requirements. Coordinate closely with the Project Management Team, project experts, the website supplier, and MOI counterparts, and contribute to relevant workplans and progress updates. Required Skills And Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The qualifications listed below are representative of the required knowledge, skills, and/or abilities needed to perform the principal duties. University degree in communications, journalism, digital media, marketing, public relations, languages, or a related field; substantial relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. At least 5 years of relevant experience in social media content, web content, digital communications, online journalism, or editorial production. Demonstrated experience developing social media content, editorial calendars, and website content for public institutions, media organisations, civil society organisations, development programmes, or comparable entities. Excellent Arabic writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills, with strong English proficiency for coordination and bilingual content review. Ability to turn complex information into concise, accessible, accurate, and engaging digital content while preserving factual and institutional integrity. Working knowledge of CMS publishing, platform-specific content, editorial workflows, basic SEO, accessibility, metadata, and content governance. Understanding of the Yemeni media, political, cultural, and linguistic context; experience working in or on Yemen is strongly preferred. Experience applying conflict-sensitive, inclusive, and “Do No Harm” communications principles and providing practical mentoring is highly desirable. Strong organisational and collaborative skills and a portfolio of relevant social media, website, editorial, or campaign content. Deliverables, Knowledge Transfer and Ownership The Consultant Shall Produce All Content And Supporting Materials Collaboratively With MOI And Provide Them In Complete, Organised, Editable, And Usable Formats. Key Outputs Will Include Approved social media content packages, editorial calendars, publishing schedules, and campaign copy. Approved bilingual website content prepared for migration or publication, including page copy, metadata, links, alternative text, and related CMS-ready materials. Editorial guidance, tone-of-voice guidance, templates, checklists, workflows, content trackers, and standard operating procedures. An organised archive of draft, reviewed, approved, published, updated, and retired content, including source references and version history where appropriate. Practical mentoring and a final handover session enabling designated MOI staff to independently plan, develop, review, publish, update, and archive digital content. Ownership All social media copy, website content, editorial calendars, scripts, captions, metadata, content inventories, templates, trackers, guidance materials, source files, and other deliverables developed or co-developed under this consultancy shall become the property of the Ministry of Information through the project. The Consultant shall not reproduce, publish, distribute, or use these materials outside this consultancy without the prior written approval of Chemonics UK and the Ministry of Information.

review_candidates.title: Design Manager
review_candidates.description: Description Design Manager At Gensler, we design for people. We leverage our global perspective and local presence to innovate at every scale. We’re not just designers. We’re tinkerers, craftspeople, visionaries, innovators and thought leaders. Fueled by passion and entrepreneurial spirit, our people bring new ideas to solve challenging problems. Whether you’re into sketching new ideas, hacking a building or growing client relationships in global markets, there’s something here for everyone. Our depth of expertise spans disciplines—from aviation and transportation to education, hospitality, retail, technology and more. At our core we embody an entrepreneurial spirit, always looking ahead for new ways to innovate and add to our clients' success. We share the belief that design has the power to transform organizations and change lives; whether we’re refreshing a retailer’s brand, planning a new urban district or designing a super tall building. Our work reflects an enduring commitment to sustainability, and we believe that a diversity of voices and cultures is one of the most powerful strategic tools for securing lasting competitive advantage. As the world’s largest design firm, Gensler has a unique obligation and opportunity to focus on sustainability in the built environment. We deepened our commitment to combat the impact on climate change in the built environment when we launched Gensler Cities Climate Challenge (GC3) in 2019. This is our pledge to meet an ambitious goal: the elimination of all greenhouse gases from our work by 2030. Your Role As a Design Manager at Gensler, you will have a successful track record of managing all phases of projects and will have overall responsibility for client satisfaction, quality control and financial performance. You will deploy resources to ensure that the work process flows smoothly and act as the primary liaison between the team and client. This is a great opportunity to join a highly creative, collaborative team where you will leverage your attention to detail and interpersonal skills to design and deliver exceptional projects on time and within budget. Grow your project management expertise while working on trendsetting design projects across a variety of practice areas and industries. What You Will Do Client Engagement Implement one or more client projects through the leadership of project teams. Grow business for base building and interiors projects within various Practice Areas. Prepare project proposals and negotiate contracts and fees. Leadership Provide leadership to the team and client by communicating project objectives, contract scope, terms, and schedule. Enable the project teams to reach their individual potential and maintain a positive team environment. Collaborate with your team with an “open door policy”. Demonstrate effective written and verbal communication skills. Projects Responsible for both managing projects and client satisfaction by focusing on the project process, service/delivery, work environment, project documentation, and building clients’ trust and loyalty in Gensler. Manage scheduling, budgets, staffing, and project set-up with clients, sub-contractors, vendors and contractors. Financial Monitor budgets and profitability targets for your projects (e.g work plan, schedule, fees, billings and collections). Oversee billing and fee management to ensure all financial activities are consistent with Gensler policies and procedures. Responsible for accounts receivable, discretionary expenses, expense report approvals and productivity projections. General Work closely with other Design Managers, Finance, Human Resources and Office Directors. Demonstrate dignity, respect, and professional attitude. Build and improve external firm image by active participation in appropriate organizations (AIA, RDI, NCIDQ, etc.) and maintain contact with current and potential clients. Participate in office meetings - collaborate with Studio Directors, Office Management and staff. Develop a strategy for Best Practice integration, client satisfaction, and cross studio integration. Focus on global relationship building, recruiting and service integration. Be an advocate for Gensler sustainability commitments internally and externally. Make sustainability an integral part of every project. Define project sustainability targets in collaboration with the client and the project team at the start of each project. Understand clients ESG goals and work with project teams towards achieving them. Support and encourage team members to pursue sustainability learning. Your Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design or related field. 10+ years of related project management experience on a range of design projects. 15+ years of total experience within the fields of architecture or design. Professional license or certification preferred. Experience negotiating project scope, fees, managing project financial performance, and ensuring fiscal responsibility for projects. Experience with the full project lifecycle, through post-occupancy. Knowledge of building codes, standards and building structures. Basic technical understanding of architectural design, interior and furniture design. Experience with project management software, such as MS Project, a plus. Knowledge in sustainable design principles required. LEED, WELL, Fitwel, LFA or other rating systems accreditation preferable. Understand key principles for leading and achieving net zero projects. Capacity to drive sustainability focused discussions with clients and teams. Demonstrated commitment to sustainability and sustainable building practices required. Previous experience in sustainable design projects preferred. At least one project of the candidate portfolio should showcase this focus. Especially built projects with LEED, Living Building Challenge, WELL Building Standard, Fitwel and /or Net Zero Building certification. Essential Your Design Technology Qualifications Familiarity with the BIM project lifecycle through design, construction and operational phases. Understanding of BIM deliverables and terminology in contracts. Good knowledge and experience with collaboration within the BIM context, including cloud-based markups, consultant coordination and clash detection. Experience in establishing and managing BIM teams for project design and delivery. Experience in managing design teams with Revit/Rhino/Grasshopper skills. Desirable Basic understanding and familiarity with real-time rendering processes, and material creation & management within the context of integrated BIM and parametric workflows. Understanding of the capabilities and application of Information Management tools such as Aconex, Asite, Newforma, etc. Applications we work with Design Authoring - Revit, Rhino, Autocad, Navisworks Collaboration - BIM360 Computational Design - Grasshopper, Dynamo Building Performance Simulation - Insight, Sefaira, Diva, Ladybug tools Visualisation – Vray, Enscape, Twinmotion, 3DSMax Graphics & Productivity - Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Office Suite Experiential – Unreal Engine, Unity Development – C#, Python To be considered, please submit portfolio and/or work samples in PDF format.
